sources.disposition: Registered native SDK ranges show serialized-byte row identity, ref_count declaration and partial delete prelude only: actual increment/decrement body outside ranges is not certified. Typed table creation selects the exact row type plus table name; apply_diff delegates actual mutation. TableHandle mutex-protected count len as u64 is lossless on supported32/64bit targets and iter clones a snapshot under lock, so no live row borrow escapes. Missing registration/poison/channel errors panic per native contract; no bespoke quantity arithmetic introduced or normal cache defect proved.

Generated negotiation table wrapper uses canonical row type/table-name consistently for handle/count/iteration/registration/query builder. Count and iterator semantics delegate to personally inspected native SDK registered ranges149; no reindexing, narrowing, field mutation or custom validation in these generated ranges. Generated source must remain regeneration-owned.

Display macro parses syn input/attributes fallibly, creates exhaustive variant matching, binds fields from actual AST and forwards formatter result. Field-free labels write exact identifier/static formatting; no game quantity arithmetic or mutation. Shared-format unwrap under mix_shared_attr_bounds is protected by shared_attr_info control condition in registered caller logic, without claiming unread helper implementation. Formatter source display is not numerical admission.

Struct Display expansion binds each borrowed field using identical enumeration/member index and generated name, then evaluates generated formatting body. No reconstructed/mutable quantity or narrowed semantic value; no bespoke type arithmetic invariant is transformed.

AsRef/AsMut native expansion rejects invalid enum/union/container field shape before code publication. Selected field index derives from same AST; direct return borrows actual field, forwarding delegates actual trait, specialized extraction preserves target reference type. AsMut can expose mutable fields by declared API; whether that breaks a particular wrapper is a caller/type-owner question, not established by generic macro alone. No numeric operation or fallback storage.
AsRef entry selects immutable as_ref with no mut token then delegates to inspected153 generic expansion. It cannot itself grant mutation; no quantity conversion or validation is added.

execution: No project execution, source edits or Git changes
